_comment: Zodiac Specialization traits, transcribed from the official Jan 9 2025 update notes (Trials of Power – 'Improvements to Zodiacs', ud.floor.line.games/us/bbsCmn/detail/1736760579410018644). Node order follows the tables in the notes. Point caps from the official beginner guide: Specialization I and II up to 7 points, Specialization III up to 9. Node types: Moon (entry), Star, Sun, Cosmos.

[Acceleration] Attack Speed +20%, Cast Speed +20%, Movement Speed +15% (permanent, does not stack with same-name effect)
[Convert Mana] Convert 1% of Max HP to Mana per stack on skill use (Max 5 stacks, Max 200); at max stacks gain Charged Mana: +20% Mana Regen/Sec for 2 s
